publication_status: Published provisional profile — checklist review remains separate
taxonomy_summary: Platypus formosanus Niijima & Murayama, 1925. Original publication and subsequent nomenclatural qualifications are documented below.

taxonomic_history.event: Replacement name (historical name; taxonomic necessity disputed)
taxonomic_history.name: Platypus taiwansis
taxonomic_history.note: Original nomen novum documented on p.111; later treatment of necessity and species synonymy remains independent.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus formosanus
taxonomic_history.note: Original account pp. 215–216; original name and description verified.

nomenclature_note: Schedl (1960:111) proposed Platypus taiwansis as a replacement name. Beaver (2013) considered this treatment unnecessary. Beaver (2013) and Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) differ on synonymy with Platypus indicus; no taxonomic merger is adopted here.
